heroText: Lusail works best as a base in Qatar when you anchor days around Lusail Boulevard, Lusail Stadium and Place Vendome Qatar. Use those sights to understand the city's history, street life and visitor rhythm. Doha International Airport (DIA) handles the main arrival flow, so hotel choice should balance the centre, transfer time and day-trip plans.

history.text: A 2021 investigation by The Guardian revealed that over 6,500 migrant workers from Bangladesh, India, Pakistan, Nepal and Sri Lanka died between 2010 and 2020 during construction of World Cup venues in Qatar.
Lusail Stadium was inaugurated on 9 September 2022 with the Lusail Super Cup game.

Owned by the Qatar Football Association, it is the largest stadium in Qatar and the Middle East by capacity; one of eight stadiums built for the 2022 FIFA World Cup, it hosted the 2022 FIFA World Cup final game between Argentina and France on 18 December 2022.
